# sharecli

> Shared CLI process manager for multi-project agent orchestration (Rust).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent contract — build/test/lint, key files, forbidden ops
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): short stack + phenotype worktree rules
- [README.md](README.md): install, quick start, feature overview
- [llms.txt](llms.txt): this file — LLM/agent index

## Specs & requirements

- [FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md](FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md): root FR-NNN index (role stories)
- [docs/specs/FR.md](docs/specs/FR.md): canonical FR-001..FR-005 + acceptance criteria
- [docs/specs/TRACEABILITY.md](docs/specs/TRACEABILITY.md): FR ↔ source ↔ test matrix
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): product/design notes
- [PRD.md](PRD.md): product requirements summary
- [BOUNDARY.md](BOUNDARY.md): repo boundary vs archived thegent-sharecli

## Plans & backlog

- [WORK_DAG.md](WORK_DAG.md): claimable S/M tasks with FR refs and predecessors
- [PLAN.md](PLAN.md): human roadmap (points at WORK_DAG)
- [TEST_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md](TEST_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md): FR → test coverage status

## Journeys & friction

- [docs/journeys/index.md](docs/journeys/index.md): user journey index
- [docs/journeys/quick-start.md](docs/journeys/quick-start.md): install → configure → run
- [docs/friction-log.md](docs/friction-log.md): known UX friction linked to FRs

## Code layout

- [src/](src/): CLI binary + library (`main`, `commands`, `runtime`, `config`, `monitoring`)
- [crates/](crates/): workspace crates (core, ipc, ffi, thermal-tui, fleet, …)
- [tests/](tests/): acceptance + integration (`fr001_*`, `cast_*`, `integration_cli`)
- [desktop/](desktop/): desktop companion surfaces
- [config/](config/): sample / schema config assets

## Build & verify

```bash
# toolchain pinned by rust-toolchain.toml (stable + rustfmt + clippy)
cargo build --locked --all-features
just test          # or: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
just lint          # clippy -D warnings
just fmt-check
```

- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): fmt, clippy, test
